predatory animal head with visible teeth/muzzle

justification: Both surfaces stack animal figures in superimposed tiers on a tall vertical shaft and both combine a large-headed predatory beast with splayed, clearly-digited paws over a small subordinate humanoid figure, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A presents flat profile silhouettes including birds, snakes and a net/zigzag band with a row of identical quadrupeds, while B depicts bulky frontal figures in the round with no bird, snake or patterned band at all.
